reparse.method: each zip re-parsed independently with ml/events/vocabulary.json; per-file sum of row hashes over file_date, symbol, company, category_raw, text, text_len, cat_method, layout, n_cont, line_no, bundle, bm_date compared with events_raw.parquet

pit_cells.method: independent loop implementation of EVENTS.md section 4 (checks.recompute_cell) on the raw zips re-parsed with the fixed vocabulary, restricted to files dated <= t and prices dated <= t; the classification rules re-run on that restricted set; tolerance rtol 1e-5

delete_future.method: every file and every price row dated after the month-end removed, the whole pipeline (classification, results rules, coverage, features) re-run, rows <= month-end compared exactly

shift.method: build 1: bundles dated <= T0 with all prices; build 2: the full parquet (every later bundle appended); rows dated <= T0 compared exactly

ab_join.path: ml.improve.ab.load_frame(ml/data_10y, extra=ml/data_ext/event_features_10y.parquet): merge on date, ticker, validate one_to_one, row count unchanged

reparse_stratified_run.method: each zip re-parsed independently with ml/events/vocabulary.json; per-file sum of row hashes over file_date, symbol, company, category_raw, text, text_len, cat_method, layout, n_cont, line_no, bundle, bm_date compared with events_raw.parquet

pit_cells_stratified.method: supplement to the random cells: per_stratum random cells (seed 108) from each stratum (rows where the named value is present), same recompute as pit_cells: independent loop implementation of EVENTS.md section 4 (checks.recompute_cell) on the raw zips re-parsed with the fixed vocabulary, restricted to files dated <= t and prices dated <= t; the classification rules re-run on that restricted set; tolerance rtol 1e-5
